Web Testing Application - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
A simple web application with:
- Registration form page (name, email, phone)
- Users listing page (table format)
- Built with Node.js and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS
- No external dependencies required

## Testing
This application is designed for manual and automated testing of form submission and data display functionality.

## How to Run
1. Execute: `npm start`
2. Navigate to: http://localhost:3000
3. The server runs on port 3000

## Project Features
- Registration form with validation
- Real-time user listing
- RESTful API endpoints
- In-memory user storage
- Responsive design
